description: ACCDB: session 1 creates Node(ID PK, ParentID), P1(ID PK), C1(ID PK), C2(ID PK, PID UNIQUE) and closes; session 2 appends (1) self-referencing R_Self(Node.ID->Node.ParentID, 0), (2) R_UniPk(P1.ID->C1.ID, dbRelationUnique=1), (3) R_UniUx(P1.ID->C2.PID, dbRelationUnique=1), and (4) R_UniNonUnique(P1.ID->Node.ParentID, dbRelationUnique=1). Keeps all pages after each Append, after 1500ms pause, and after Close; read-only reopen reads Relations and all Indexes.
